translations.web: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
translations.bsb: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre
translations.asv: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
